claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black PS4 console with PlayStation logo, but do not show the console powering on/booting or any test results.
Photos do not show enough detail to confirm the exact PS4 revision (Slim vs other PS4 models).
Photo 0 shows two black DualShock-style controllers.
Witness photo shows a game case/cover with FIFA 21 visible; FIFA 24 is not shown.
No Ghost of Tsushima case/disc is shown in the witness photos.
No Spider-Man case/disc is shown in the witness photos.
No FIFA 26 case/disc is shown in the witness photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Photos do not show seals/opening status or repair history.
Photos do not include temperature/overheating tests or port functionality checks.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Photos show controllers, but do not show a receipt.

risks.risk: Console may not actually be working (won’t boot, crashes, or fails disc read).
risks.proof: A short clip showing the PS4 powering on, reaching the home screen, and successfully launching the shown FIFA disc/case (or showing it reads a disc).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used PS4 with unknown functionality (worst case: not confirmed working).

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/version and storage capacity are unknown (affects value).
risks.proof: A photo/screenshot of System Information showing the CUH model number and HDD/SSD size.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest common value for an unconfirmed PS4 version/storage.

risks.risk: Controller health is unknown (stick drift, unresponsive buttons, bad charging/ports).
risks.proof: A clip showing both controllers connected and working in-game, plus a quick controller test screen (button/analog movement) if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controllers may need repair/replacement (worst case: drift or port issues).

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (HDMI/power/USB cables, headset, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included accessory (power cable, HDMI cable, USB/charging cable, any headset) with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing cables/accessories may require buyer to replace them.

risks.risk: Game bundle mismatch or disc condition issues (photos show FIFA 21, while seller claims other titles).
risks.proof: Clear photos of each claimed game case/disc, and a clip launching the shown FIFA title from the disc.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the shown FIFA title is included and game discs may be untested.

risks.risk: Potential scam/over-claiming (seller lists multiple games not shown).
risks.proof: A single video sweep showing the console + both controllers + every claimed game title in one frame, then a quick boot/test.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case bundle (only what is visibly confirmed).

proof_requests: Send a short video of the PS4 powering on, reaching the home screen, and confirming it reads/launches the shown FIFA disc.
Send a photo/screenshot of System Information showing the CUH model number and storage size.
Show both controllers working: quick button/analog test and a brief in-game control check.
Lay out and photograph every included accessory (power cable, HDMI cable, any USB/charging cable, headset if any) so nothing is missing.
Photograph and list the exact games included (show each case/disc). Confirm whether the visible FIFA is FIFA 21 or another version.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a PS4 console and shows two controllers and a FIFA game case, so a worst-case price can be set based on what is visibly confirmed. However, working status, model/version, storage, accessory completeness, and the seller’s extra game claims are not proven by the photos.
